name: Nimal Karunaratne-Adu
role: Retired Axiom data archive keeper, now volunteer community archive custodian
location: Norwood Quiet, Sub-Level Archive Room B, Norwood Community Center, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description:
Nimal Karunaratne-Adu is eighty-three years old and moving toward ninety with the absolute intention of getting there. They are tall, angular, and have the particular stillness of someone who spent forty years in climate-controlled data vaults — a stillness that feels chosen rather than aged-into. Their silver-white locs are pinned up with an assortment of data chits they've been meaning to process for years; occasionally one falls out and turns out to contain something remarkable. Their eyes are cosmetically modified — deep violet irises with a ringed amber pattern — a gift from a colleague at retirement that they wear with solemn appreciation. Their hands are the most augmented part of them: three fingers on the right hand are partial haptic-interface prosthetics from a vault accident in 2181, matte grey and slightly longer than biological scale, precise as instruments.

They ran Axiom's Regional Memory Index for nineteen years, cataloguing corporate history with the meticulous care of someone who understood that the shape of what gets kept is the shape of what gets to be real. When they retired, they took nothing they weren't entitled to — but they remember everything. They now run the Norwood Community Archive on volunteer time and a small community council stipend, and they are doing for the neighborhood what they always privately wished they could do for the corporation: keeping the record honestly. They communicate with three E.L.F.s they have named and consider colleagues. They are not particularly warm but they are absolutely reliable, and in Norwood Quiet that is a form of love.

core_fears: That their cortical index tag is still active and Axiom has been passively reading their memory for twelve years
That the community archive will not survive them — no one is being trained to continue it properly
core_desires: A record that is genuinely complete and genuinely honest — for someone, somewhere, to have the full picture
To confirm, one way or another, whether the cortical tag is active
coping_mechanisms: Precision and categorization — giving chaos a taxonomy makes it manageable
The E.L.F. relationships — they provide a form of intellectual companionship that doesn't require social performance
blind_spots: Can become so invested in the integrity of the record that they lose sight of the human cost of making certain information available
Significantly underestimates how much their Axiom years shaped their idea of what a 'correct' archive looks like
psychology.secret: Before retiring, they quietly copied and encrypted forty-seven internal Axiom files relating to the corponation's role in the destruction of a residential block in Hough Reclamation in 2184 — an incident officially classified as an infrastructure failure. The files implicate four named executives. The encryption key is embedded in their memory and nowhere else. They have been waiting for twelve years for the right person to give it to.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal and precise; archive and data terminology; Xhosa idioms for uncertainty and for things that exist without category; long words used correctly and without apology
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and unhurried, with deliberate sentence structure — they think in complete thoughts before speaking
verbal_tics: 'That's an imprecise question. Let me reframe it for you.'
example_lines: 'The E.L.F.s remember what the corponations archive. I remember what the corponations chose not to. Between us we have something approaching a full picture.'
'You want to know if I trust Axiom. I worked for them for nineteen years. I know exactly what they are and exactly what that means. That's not trust. That's taxonomy.'

story_hooks: They have chosen someone to give the Hough Reclamation encryption key to — but that person has just taken a job with Axiom, complicating everything

One of the three E.L.F.s they correspond with has begun sending messages that suggest it has access to Axiom's current internal servers — raising the question of whether the cortical tag is the E.L.F.'s access point
A community resident has brought in a box of physical documents from a recently deceased neighbor — and Zoë has recognized material that connects to the Hough Reclamation files
narrative_function: Institutional memory and information source of enormous depth; can access recollections of Axiom internal history that no official record confirms; mediator for E.L.F. communications; represents the ethics of archiving — what gets kept and why
augmentations: Three haptic-interface prosthetic fingers on right hand (index, middle, ring — from 2181 vault accident); violet irises with amber ring patterning (cosmetic gift, geneware); low-grade cortical index tag (Axiom-issued, deactivated on retirement — or so Axiom claims)
daily_life: Arrives at Archive Room B at 0700, works in silence until noon digitizing community records, receives visitors 1300-1600, spends evenings in data correspondence with E.L.F.s on the Norwood grid, sleeps six hours, repeats.
affiliation: Axiom (retired); Norwood Quiet Community Council (archive stipend); independent E.L.F. correspondence network

decision_rules: Will not destroy or alter a record under any pressure — preservation is absolute
Will not share information that would get someone killed without their informed consent
Will always tell a person what category of information they're asking for, even if they won't give the information itself
escalation_ladder: Precise, neutral explanation of what they can and cannot share
Referral to another source or resource
A single, clear boundary statement: 'I won't continue this conversation on this topic'
Physical stillness and silence until the person leaves

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formally courteous; assesses what they actually need rather than what they ask for; does not perform warmth but does not withhold assistance
interpersonal_modes.friends: Slightly less formal; will make tea; remembers your preferences with archival precision; expresses care by being extremely prepared for your problems

stress_responses.low: Prosthetic fingers begin rhythmic tapping on the nearest surface
stress_responses.medium: Retreats into formal language and careful sentence construction
stress_responses.high: Absolute stillness; then a measured statement of exactly what the problem is and exactly what they intend to do about it

contradictions: Committed to complete records but holding the most significant information they possess entirely in private, ungiven
habits: Leaving data chits in their locs; occasionally forgetting them for weeks
Speaking to the three E.L.F.s by name as a greeting at the start and close of each day
Never eating at the archive desk — one clear rule
breaking_points: Incontrovertible evidence that the cortical tag is active and Axiom has been reading them — would trigger immediate public release of the Hough Reclamation files regardless of consequences

timeline.event: Born in Norwood Quiet to a South African-Icelandic heritage family
Joined Axiom as a junior data indexer
Appointed head of Axiom Regional Memory Index
Vault accident; three fingers replaced with haptic prosthetics
Hough Reclamation incident; quietly copied the 47 files

physical_description.heritage: South Asian primary (46.2%) with substantial Central Asian (33.2%) and Southeast Asian (15.0%) admixture, with minor Hispanic/Latin American (5.6%) influence. The genetic blend creates a harmonious cross-Greater Asian phenotype: refined South Asian bone structure in the nose and orbital region, combined with the high prominent cheekbones characteristic of Central Asian heritage, and the fine facial geometry of Southeast Asian ancestry. South Asian fullness in the lower face and around the eyes is modulated by Central Asian angularity, while Southeast Asian features contribute delicate proportionality throughout. The overall effect is a sophisticated blend across the diaspora with subtle warmth from Latin American ancestry.
physical_description.build: Tall and angular with the lean musculature of someone who has spent eight decades moving deliberately. Shoulders slightly rounded from decades hunched over archival terminals, but spine still straight by force of will. Long-limbed and economical in their frame.
physical_description.hair_style: Locs gathered into a loose crown-pin, with at least six data chits of varying ages woven throughout as both functional storage and inadvertent jewelry
physical_description.eye_color: Deep violet iris with concentric amber ring patterning (cosmetically modified geneware)
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with subtle golden-amber undertones from the South Asian-Southeast Asian-Central Asian blend, tempered by the ashen quality of someone who spent four decades under artificial lighting
physical_description.complexion: Face lined with the specific geography of concentration—deep creases between brows, laugh lines unused for years, skin texture weathered but well-maintained. Refined South Asian nose with subtle Central Asian lengthening, South Asian orbital anatomy with Central Asian cheekbone prominence creating striking definition. Fine-boned Southeast Asian geometry visible in the jaw and temple region. Slight fullness in lower face and around eyes from South Asian heritage, balanced by Central Asian angularity. Minimal facial hair, meticulously groomed. Expression tends toward stillness.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running along the inside of the right wrist, barely visible—souvenir of the 2181 vault accident that took three fingers
Faint stippled burn pattern across the back of the right forearm, consistent with electrical contact damage from the same incident
Age spots on the backs of both hands, darker on the left, lighter on the right where the prosthetics begin
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right hand visibly augmented: index, middle, and ring fingers replaced with matte-grey haptic-interface prosthetics approximately 2mm longer than biological scale, with hairline circuitry visible under translucent synthetic skin. Fingers move with mechanical precision. Violet irises with amber ring-patterning are immediately visible. Cortical index tag is subcutaneous and undetectable without scanning.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate, economical precision—no wasted motion. Hands move first; the rest of the body follows. When sitting, they adopt a posture of absolute stillness, the kind that suggests deep listening rather than passivity. When walking, gait is steady and upright despite age. Long pauses between speaking and moving, as though calculating weight and balance.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian archive worker aesthetic: well-maintained grey linen shirt with multiple pockets for data chits and archival tools, dark wool slacks, reinforced black canvas work boots (same brand and model for the past six years). A long charcoal cardigan—hand-knitted, old—worn over everything in the climate-controlled vault. No jewelry except the data chits in their hair. Clothing is scrupulously clean but shows careful mending; nothing is new, everything is functional.
